    return list(map(dtype, input().split()))


n, = read()
s, = read(str)

dp = [[inf, inf], [inf, inf]]
dp[s[0] ^ 1][0] = c[0]
dp[s[0]][0] = 0
for i in range(1, n):
    ndp = [[inf, inf], [inf, inf]]
    for k in range(2):
        cost = k * c[i]
        for x in range(2):
            for y in range(2):
                same = s[i] == (x ^ k)
                if y and same:
                    continue

                ndp[s[i] ^ k][same | y] = min(
                    ndp[s[i] ^ k][same | y], dp[x][y] + cost)
    dp = ndp
print(min(dp[0][1], dp[1][1]))
